title: WING WALL PILE REPAIR DETAIL – TYPE WW2

details.name: ELEVATION – WING WALL PILE REPAIR DETAIL – TYPE WW2

ents.s: WING WALL PILE REPAIR DETAIL – TYPE WW2
1. FOR GENERAL NOTES REFER DRAWING No. 1330-0001.
2. EXTENT OF DETERIORATED TIMBER PILE SHALL BE DETERMINED ON SITE BY DRILLING.
3. IF MINIMUM 100 SOLID TIMBER ANNULUS NOT ACHIEVABLE WITHIN 1500 FROM TOP OF PILE,
THE ENGINEER IS TO PROVIDE AN ALTERNATE DESIGN.
